title: Velveting Beef
steps: Scale the recipe to the desired quantity of beef.
Cut the beef into 1–1.5-inch strips with the grain, followed by ¼-inch slices against the grain.
Combine the beef, baking soda, and water and tenderize for 1–2 hours.
Rinse the baking soda from the beef and drain.
Combine the beef with oyster or soy sauce, cornstarch, oil, and Shaoxing wine. Marinate for another 15 minutes.
Stir-fry as required in your Chinese recipe.
